|lore=Ugly scars cover this former commando from southern Nentan. Likes to be on his own. Crack shot. Off and on partner of Debnoli. Relies on intuition to survive.
|game_text=Where present, cancels Dark side site game text (except docking bay transit). Blaster rifle is a 'matching weapon' for Bron and deploys and fires for free. Draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. Immune to attrition < 4 while armed with a weapon.
|errata_history=Versions of [[Bron Burs (V)]] in [[Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time]], in date order (2 versions). Slip texts are quoted as printed: ▼ and ▲ are the slips' arrow icons (deploy from / take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle), and the immunity and pilot icons are the ones explained in each sheet's icon key (see [[Virtual card icons]]). Found while adding the original pre-Remaster slips (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): first release sheet “Virtual Set #5” (Players Committee, 30 May 2003; tournament legal 6 June 2003), page 1, slip 3 — [https://web.archive.org/web/20030801181811/http://www.theforce.net/ccg/vcards/SWCCGVirtualSet5.pdf PDF on theforce.net] linked from the [https://web.archive.org/web/20030603182926/http://swccgpc.com:80/interior.htm PC news post of 30 May 2003] (Internet Archive capture of the PDF, 1 August 2003; PDF dated 30–31 May 2003): “Where present, cancels Dark side site game text (except docking bay transit). Blaster rifle is a 'matching weapon' for Bron and deploys and fires for free. Draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. Immune to attrition < 4 while armed with a weapon.” Stats line: “POWER 2 ABILITY 3 FORCE-ATTUNED”. Deploy 2, forfeit 4. The slip is the old pre-template slip the Committee used before its December 2006 Remaster: the Decipher-style lower half with the slip mark “5•3” at bottom right and no expansion icon. The revised sheet of 11 June 2003 (PDF dated 11 June 2003; the copy the Players Committee still hosts at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards5.pdf res.starwarsccg.org]) prints the same words on the same old slip ([[:File:OVS5-03-Bron_Burs-original-slip-2003-06-11.png]]).
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Bron Burs (V) (Virtual Set 5) (Errata)]]): the Remaster sheet (official text as of 4 December 2006; [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154714/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards5.pdf Internet Archive capture of 24 October 2007], slip 3), in the Committee's Remaster template: “Draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. Where present, cancels a non-docking bay site’s Dark side game text. While armed with a Blaster Rifle (which is a matching weapon for Bron), it fires for free and Bron is immune to attrition < 4.” '''What changed:''' the Remaster rewrote the slip in the Committee's later wording (full text above; icons written out in words here). This is the current text of the Virtual Original card.
